/**
 * @name Subprocess calls with shell=True
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pillow-subprocess-shell
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() and
    exists(DataFlow::Node shell_arg |
      shell_arg = call.getArgByName("shell") and
      shell_arg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
    )
  ) or
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe subprocess call with shell=True or os.system"
findings.hypothesis: Direct subprocess calls with shell=True or command execution in Pillow code

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Path traversal in file operations
 * @description Using unsanitized file paths can lead to path traversal attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/pillow-path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("PIL").getMember("Image").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall()
  ) and
  // Check if the path argument involves string concatenation or formatting
  exists(DataFlow::Node pathArg |
    pathArg = call.getArg(0) and
    (
      pathArg.asExpr() instanceof BinaryExpr or
      pathArg.asExpr().(Call).getFunc().(Attribute).getName() in ["format", "join"]
    )
  )
select call, "File operation with potentially unsafe path construction"
findings.hypothesis: Check for path traversal vulnerabilities where file paths are constructed using string operations without proper sanitization

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded credentials or secrets
 * @description Hardcoded credentials in source code can lead to unauthorized access
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pillow-hardcoded-credentials
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::Node node, string varName
where
  exists(Assign assign, Name target |
    assign.getATarget() = target and
    target.getId() = varName and
    (
      varName.toLowerCase().matches("%password%") or
      varName.toLowerCase().matches("%passwd%") or
      varName.toLowerCase().matches("%secret%") or
      varName.toLowerCase().matches("%api_key%") or
      varName.toLowerCase().matches("%apikey%") or
      varName.toLowerCase().matches("%token%") or
      varName.toLowerCase().matches("%auth%")
    ) and
    node.asExpr() = assign.getValue() and
    node.asExpr() instanceof StrConst
  )
select node, "Potential hardcoded credential in variable '" + varName + "'"
findings.hypothesis: Check for hardcoded credentials, API keys, or secrets in the codebase
